text: I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa[1] when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam[2] son of Jehoash[3] was king of Israel. Two years before the earthquake,[4] the LORD gave me several messages[5] about Israel,
and I said: When the LORD roars from Jerusalem, pasturelands and Mount Carmel dry up and turn brown.
The LORD said: I will punish Syria[6] for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged logs with spikes[7] over the people of Gilead.
Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.[8]

I will break through the gates of Damascus. I will destroy the people[9] of Wicked Valley[10] and the ruler of Beth-Eden.[11] Then the Syrians will be dragged as prisoners to Kir.[12] I, the LORD, have spoken!
The LORD said: I will punish Philistia[13] for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people[14] from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
That's why I will burn down the walls and fortresses of the city of Gaza.
I will destroy the king[15] of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron,[16] and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the LORD, have spoken!

The LORD said: I will punish Phoenicia[17] for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people[18] from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
That's why I will send flames to burn down the city of Tyre along with its fortresses.
The LORD said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives[19] and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.
Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah.[20]
The LORD said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.
Now I will send fire to destroy the walls and fortresses of Rabbah.[21] Enemies will shout and attack like a whirlwind.
Ammon's king and leaders will be dragged away. I, the LORD, have spoken!
